operations.name: custom
operations.signature: custom<T>(query: string, variables?: Record<string, unknown>, options?: RequestOptions): Promise<T>
operations.purpose: AniListCustom.custom sends a caller-authored GraphQL query or mutation document to AniList. Use it as an escape hatch when no typed operation fits: the `query` string is sent verbatim and the `variables` argument is forwarded as-is. A document with a single root field resolves to the bare field value; a document with multiple root fields resolves to the full `{ data }` envelope.
operations.auth: Not required — public data. Pass a token for viewer-scoped fields.
